title: PromptlyPlanDiffResponse
description: Response shape from the plan-diff Gemini call. The model self-classifies the re-edit as tweak (surgical preservation), reinterpret (fresh direction), or needs_clarification. When classification=tweak a full echo of the plan is returned under new_plan with minimal changes. When reinterpret, fused_vibe contains the merged creative direction. When needs_clarification, only clarification_question is populated and no render should start.

clarification_question.description: When classification=needs_clarification, the exact question to show the user.

new_plan.description: Populated only when classification=tweak. Must echo every field from the old plan except what the user explicitly changed.

fused_vibe.description: Populated only when classification=reinterpret. The merged vibe_input to feed the full pipeline.

changed_fields.description: Dotted paths of fields that differ from the old plan, e.g. ['caption_style', 'cuts[3].speed']. Empty array for reinterpret.

human_summary.description: One-sentence human-readable description of what changed and what was preserved. Shown in the result message.
